objective: Build the request and response core for AI-generated covers (eBook cover or software box) from a product title.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Create src/lib/ai-cover.ts exactly as specified in the acceptance test header: pinned model stability.stable-image-core-v1:1 in us-west-2, the two styles with their labels, buildCoverRequest(title, style) and parseCoverResponse(body).
This module is pure: it must not import AWS SDKs, Supabase, React, server-only modules or perform network, file or environment access. It must be importable by both server and client code.
The prompt must describe original artwork for the given title only; it must not ask for logos, brand names, real people or copyrighted characters.
Do not change any existing file. Later tasks add the generation endpoint, the budget and the dashboard dropdown.
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
source_manifest_note: Computed by the coding assistant from a separate read-only clone with both the Factory reader and the owner's standalone script (107 files, 679216 bytes); the Factory fetch verifies it independently before use.

owner_decisions.provider: AWS Bedrock Stable Image Core v1.1 in us-west-2 (owner console check 2026-11-01)
owner_decisions.style_selection: dropdown: eBook cover or Software box
owner_decisions.budget_usd: 2.00 total, one generation per item and style
owner_decisions.saving: owner approves each image before it becomes the cover
